content: केत {%a.%} [कित्-आधारे घञ्] Knowing, learned. .{@-तः@} .²1 A house, abode; अनन्यमेकं जगदात्मकेतं भवापवर्गाय भजाम देवम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 63. 44</ls>. .²2 Living, habitation. .²3 A banner. .²4 Will, intention, desire. .²5 Summons, invitation. .²6 Apparition, form, shape. .²7 Wealth. .²8 Atmosphere, sky. .²9 Intellect, judgment.
